articles.title: Tambaram Corporation Commissioner relieved from duty over tender irregularities
articles.description: Arappor Iyakkam had alleged that two civic works worth Rs 45.9 lakh were completed and inaugurated before the tendering process was completed.

articles.title: Tambaram commissioner placed on compulsory wait over tender ‘lapse’
articles.description: Arappor Iyakkam’s complaint alleged tender fixing in two civic projects, claiming the works were completed before bids were opened.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu Government Transfers Tambaram Commissioner Over Tender Violations
articles.description: The Tamil Nadu government has transferred Tambaram Corporation Commissioner S Balachander and placed him under compulsory wait following allegations of irregularities in the award of municipal contracts. An inquiry has been ordered by the Director of Municipal Administration.
